# Indonesian question explanations — batch 005 — 2026-10-14

## Scope

Translated the next 100 source-ordered Indonesian question explanations. The batch covers linking words, future perfect continuous, compound noun phrases, the subjunctive, cleft sentences, advanced inversion, ellipsis, hedging, formal register, and additional word-form and tense items.

Every explanation was authored from its English source explanation in `content/en/questions.json`. Question stems, options, answers, stable IDs, and taught English forms remain unchanged.
